spots.name: Residence of Bukovinian and Dalmatian Metropolitans
spots.summary: The Residence of Bukovinian and Dalmatian Metropolitans in Chernivtsi, Ukraine, was built for the Eastern Orthodox metropolitan bishop between 1864 and 1882 to the designs of the Czech architect Josef Hlávka from Austria-Hungary.

spots.name: Chernivtsi Town Hall
spots.summary: Chernivtsi Town Hall is a neoclassical historic town hall (ratusha), located at Tsentralna Square in Chernivtsi, Ukraine. Constructed from 1843 to 1847 by a Polish-Austrian architect Andreas Mikulicz von Radecki, the building is an architectural monument of national significance.
